name: Chargebee
summary: Chargebee's Flow plan costs 0.8% of monthly invoicing volume with no platform fee, or $99 a month plus 0.65%, and works with more than 40 payment gateways. Eligible venture-backed startups pay nothing until they bill their first $1 million.

facts.text: The startup offer is free until a company bills its first $1 million, for new customers that raised less than $5 million and belong to a partner program.
Smart dunning makes up to 12 retries, and custom schedules allow up to 5.
Card copying to another gateway through the API does not work for cards held at Stripe or Braintree.
Chargebee hosts accounts in the US, the EU (Frankfurt) or Australia.
A merchant of record option through Reach is in private beta.

plans.name: Flow, committed
plans.notes: Plus 0.65% of billing volume; cheaper above about $66,000 a month

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Adds SAML single sign-on, multi-entity and contract terms

hiddenCosts: Payment gateway fees are paid separately to the gateway.
HubSpot and Salesforce subscription sync are paid extras.
The terms allow a reasonable fee for help exporting data.

contract.cancellation: Flow runs month to month and ends at the close of the billing cycle after a cancellation request; fees are non-refundable.
contract.dataExport: Customers, subscriptions and invoices as CSV; data kept for 120 days after termination.
